name: Prescription sunglasses
description: Black-framed sunglasses with smoked lenses ground for short sight. They cut glare and sharpen the distance for a near-sighted wearer.
notes: Open, standing on the lens rims, front on +z, the arms running back and hooking down behind: 140 mm across, 45 mm tall, 160 mm deep. Lenses in `glass-lens-green`, which stays see-through in the game. The arms stand open. Slot `eyes`, as Deadvox's night-vision goggles have it. The corrective effect for near-sighted wearers is left to the eyesight rules. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Reading sunglasses
description: Brown-framed sunglasses with tinted magnifying lenses for a far-sighted reader. Anyone else sees a blur through them.
notes: Shares the `prescription_sunglasses` model: the same open frame, recoloured with a brown frame and amber-tinted lenses so the two pairs tell apart. `leather-brown` stands in for brown tortoiseshell plastic, which has no finish. Slot `eyes`. The magnifying effect is left to the eyesight rules. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Canvas aketon
description: A thick padded jacket quilted from a dozen layers of canvas, made to go under armour. It turns a blade and softens a blow on its own.
notes: Folded on a shelf, collar at the +z end and the hem folded under at -z: 380 mm by 340 mm and 70 mm tall in four layers, with quilted channels down the front, a stand collar, the quilted sleeves folded in along each side and leather toggles closing the front. Slot `torso`: it is worn under armour, and brigandines take `vest`, so the two layer. The sleeves also reach the arms. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Canvas aketon vest
description: A sleeveless padded vest quilted from a dozen layers of canvas and laced up the front, made to go under armour.
notes: Folded on a shelf, collar at the +z end: 340 mm by 320 mm and 50 mm tall in three layers, with quilted channels, a stand collar, the armholes marked at both shoulders and leather laces crossing down the front. Slot `torso`, not `vest`: it is padding under armour, and brigandines take `vest`, so the two layer. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Canvas arming gloves
description: Quilted canvas gloves thin enough to wear under gauntlets. They keep the hands safe in a fight.
notes: The model's root, in `cloth-canvas` with a khaki cuff. Laid flat side by side, backs up, fingers towards +z: quilted gloves 230 mm from cuff to fingertip with channels over the back of the hand, two quilted segments per finger and a short flared cuff. The pair lies spread flat with the thumbs out. Slot `hands`, as earlier clothing batches name it for gloves; these are meant to go under gauntlets, which also take `hands`, so wearing both waits on layered slots. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.

name: Canvas coif
description: A padded canvas hood that covers the head, neck and forehead and rests on the shoulders. Warm, tough, and made to cushion a helmet.
notes: Standing upright as on a shelf, face opening on +z: 290 mm across the shoulder cape and 260 mm tall, a quilted round crown ringed with channels, a bound oval face opening and a neck flaring into the cape. Its padding holds it open round an empty head and the cape spreads wide. Slot `head`: it is meant under a helmet, which also takes `head`, so wearing both waits on layered slots. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored. Slot hood: worn under a helmet, which takes head.
